messages.author: 1557f895f706963e
messages.subject: Packages on shinyapps.io
parts: How do I make sure an app on shinyapps.io has access to all the packages I need? Is a call to library() or require() enough, or do I need to make the server run install.packages() or biocLite() with some appropriate mirror? What if I want to tell the server to use a specific version of a package that Rstudio doesn't have or a package that I'm writing but haven't released yet?

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Packages on shinyapps.io
parts:
You only need to have the library() call in your code.  shinyapps will pick up which versions of the packages you are using and re-install them on the server.  That does mean that the packages you are using have to be on CRAN, Github (private or public) or BioConductor.  
For private packages, you would want to put it in on a private repo on Github.

Hope this helps.
-Tareef
